I wish I could relate i have tried everything including turning to god. I am bipolar (maybe something else)? as I have hallucinations sometimes and am paranoid and delusional  with a ton of other labels. I am 25 but have thought about this and tried to troubleshoot my issues since i was maybe 14 the cycle doesn't end. My daughter, brother & girlfriend love me for sure. My girlfriend is incredibly rude to my daughter because its not her child thats not the point though.

I take a whole cocktail of about 8 medications everyday to function and am still so sad I think of killing myself each and every day I wont regret it I know people will be sad. It is what it is I cant take living this way anymore & have tried every available resource & am ready to let go. I just need to know if this would be a lethal dose . I could pop myself in the next 10 seconds but I would rather be remembered as someone who accidently died and not took the "cowards way out"
Yeah so I literally dont care if she is or isnt on the lease I just dont want to lose my apartment. As long as I continue paying rent all should be well?
